methodology.half_initial_allocation: At priceP and lotL, with N=P*L and feeF=max(rate*N,minimum), capitalC must satisfy C>=2N+F to buy one lot without exceeding the post-fee50% target. Model has no actual broker fee rounding.
methodology.ten_percent_order: Signal NAV must be at least10 times the next-open one-lot notional for an intended10%-NAV order to reach one lot. Cash, position bounds and overnight gaps can impose additional restrictions.
methodology.interpretation: Ability to open a position does not imply ability to execute later grid orders. Do not round intended orders upward without defining and separately validating a new sizing protocol.
